text:
When a hot gas is left to cool, its internal energy decreases.
What causes this?
A
a decrease in the kinetic energy of the gas particles
B
a decrease in the gravitational potential energy of the gas particles
C
an increase in the average speed of the gas particles
D
an increase in the average distance of separation of the gas particles

options.label: A
options.text: a decrease in the kinetic energy of the gas particles

options.label: B
options.text: a decrease in the gravitational potential energy of the gas particles

options.label: C
options.text: an increase in the average speed of the gas particles

options.label: D
options.text: an increase in the average distance of separation of the gas particles
